description.value:
Duration 1 minute or until you move

Designate your space and every space within your reach as held ground. Enemies treat that area as difficult terrain, and an enemy that attempts to move through your own space must succeed at an Athletics check against your Class DC or the movement is wasted. You lose all of this the moment you move.

cinderfall.incomplete: Designates the caster's space and reach as held ground for 1 minute or until they move: enemies treat it as difficult terrain, and a mover through the caster's own space needs an Athletics check versus Class DC or wastes the movement. No selector imposes difficult terrain or a movement-check gate on other creatures from the caster's own action, and no companion effect exists to carry a zone-control mechanic of this shape.
